A '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] during the second main offensive of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battle resulted in a victory for the forces of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Agamar was first mentioned on the [http://www.swtor.com official site] for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Sith Empire's entry in [[The Holonet]] section of the site.<ref name="Holonet" />
